```{r clean environment, echo=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
```


```{r load libraries, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library (data.table)
library(writexl)
library(table1)
library(tableone)
library(flextable)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library (sjPlot)
library (sjlabelled)
library(data.table) 
library(ggplot2)
library("gplots")
library(pheatmap)
library(here)
library(officer)
library(boot)
library(purrr)
```

```{r define path}
#herre::here() #check folder path
basedir <- here()
```

```{r read in excel on combine all sheets to one file, include=FALSE}
file <- here("data","CarTrans_Donor_Information.xlsx")

# Map together different sheets
sheets <- excel_sheets(file)

data_list <- map(sheets,
  ~ read_excel(file, sheet = .x)
)

names(data_list) <- sheets

# Convert them into individual data frames
purrr::map(names(data_list),
~assign(.x, data_list[[.x]], envir = .GlobalEnv)
)

str(data_list)

data <- data_list
```

```{r mutate data}

# Mutate factors and define different levels

## Clinical Data
data$`Clinical Characteristics` <- data$`Clinical Characteristics` |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    
     ### Sex
    sex = dplyr::case_when(
      sex == "M" ~ "Male",
      sex == "F" ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
    

# Mutate class 
data$`Clinical Characteristics`$age <- as.numeric(data$`Clinical Characteristics`$age)
data$`Clinical Characteristics`$waiting_time_days <- as.numeric(data$`Clinical Characteristics`$waiting_time_days)
```

```{r rename columns}
data$`Clinical Characteristics` <- data$`Clinical Characteristics` |>
  dplyr::rename(
    "Age" = age,
    "Sex" = sex,
    "Leading event" =generalcause,
    "Allocation status deceased donor" = death_type,
    "OCS (Heart in a box)" = OCS,
    "Time on Waitlist (d)" = waiting_time_days
  )

data$`Transplantation Matching` <- data$`Transplantation Matching` |>
  dplyr::rename(
    "Sex mismatch" = sex_mismatch,
    "AB0 mismatch" = AB0_mismatch
  )
    
```

```{r merge different lists into one dataframe}
clin <- as.data.frame(data$`Clinical Characteristics`)
transp <- as.data.frame(data$`Transplantation Matching`)


# With merge only to dataframes can be merged, merging every dataframe sequentially
df <- merge(clin, transp, by = "ID", all.x = TRUE)

# Sanity check
any(duplicated(names(df)))
```

```{r table1 for overall}
caption  <- "Donor characteristics CarTrans cohort overall"
#footnote <- "* late rejection: severe rejection ≥ ACR2R, ≥4 months after transplantation"


table1(~ Age + Sex + `Leading event` + `Allocation status deceased donor`+ `OCS (Heart in a box)`+ `Time on Waitlist (d)` + `Sex mismatch` + `AB0 mismatch`,
  data = df,
  overall = c(left = "Overall"),
  caption = caption
)
```

```{r export in word, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
t1 <- table1(~ Age + Sex + `Leading event` + `Allocation status deceased donor`+ `OCS (Heart in a box)`+ `Time on Waitlist (d)` + `Sex mismatch` + `AB0 mismatch`,
  data = df,
  overall = c(left = "Overall"),
  caption = caption
)

# Convert to data frame
t1_df <- as.data.frame(t1)

# Convert to flextable
ft <- flextable(t1_df)

# Create Word document
doc <- read_docx()
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft)

# Save
print(doc, target = "table1_donoroverall_short.docx")
```
